findings.issue: Home page re-implements card assembly (sprite fallback, species→default-pokemon join, type mapping) instead of reusing buildPokemonCards, so card-level fixes must land twice
findings.suggestion: Extend buildPokemonCards in lib/cards.js with an options object (e.g. withTypes) or a decorate callback, and have the home page consume it

findings.issue: Inline regex re-parses Pokémon IDs, duplicating idFromUrl from lib/format.js
findings.suggestion: Import idFromUrl from '@/lib/format' and delete the local regex

findings.issue: Type slot-sort plus English-name lookup duplicated from app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.jsx:152-158
findings.suggestion: Add a displayTypes(pokemon, typeData) helper to lib/format.js or lib/cards.js and use it in both pages

findings.issue: single() query-param helper defined identically in two pages (also app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.jsx:29)
findings.suggestion: Move single() into a shared module (e.g. lib/format.js) and import it

findings.issue: TypeBadge lives inside PokemonCard.jsx, so MovesSection.jsx:5 and three pages import a badge from a card component
findings.suggestion: Extract TypeBadge into its own file (components/TypeBadge.jsx)

findings.issue: compareRows hardcodes '—' as the missing-value marker, silently duplicating the displayValue contract in lib/format.js:40
findings.suggestion: Keep raw values and a missing flag in each row instead of comparing against the rendered em dash

findings.issue: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' is repeated in all 7 pages; Next 16 favours await connection() per page, and a future cacheComponents migration touches every page file
findings.suggestion: Centralise the rendering-mode decision (e.g. in the root layout or a shared route-segment config) or switch to connection()

findings.issue: Stat bar width uses unexplained magic constant (value / 180) * 100 with zero comments or JSDoc anywhere in the app (2 comment lines total)
findings.suggestion: Name the constant (MAX_BASE_STAT) with a one-line comment explaining the 180 cap

summary: A small, well-layered App Router app: all API and base-URL knowledge sits in lib/api.js, helpers are pure, and the server/client split is explicit, so most cross-cutting changes are one-file edits. The main editability cost is the home page forking the shared card builder instead of extending it, which duplicates sprite and type logic and makes card-level bug fixes two-places fixes. Secondary duplication (single(), idFromUrl regex, TypeBadge placement) is minor but easy to fix before more pages copy the pattern.
